aiEditorCatalog.name: Claude Code
aiEditorCatalog.auth: Claude Code login or Anthropic API
aiEditorCatalog.note: MERDOSS must respect Anthropic terms; do not attempt to reuse subscription credentials as an unauthorized API.

aiEditorCatalog.name: Hermes Agent
aiEditorCatalog.note: Hermes is an agent layer; its provider credentials remain separate from MERDOSS credentials.

aiEditorCatalog.name: Kimi Code
aiEditorCatalog.note: Kimi Code membership and Kimi Open Platform API are distinct products.

aiEditorCatalog.name: LM Studio
aiEditorCatalog.note: Useful CPU/local fallback; actual model performance depends strongly on hardware.

aiEditorCatalog.name: Ollama
aiEditorCatalog.note: Recommended local fallback. MERDOSS never treats a specific local model as guaranteed to exist; it checks the installed model.

aiEditorCatalog.name: OpenCode
aiEditorCatalog.note: Use as an agent/editor gateway; do not assume every model or provider is permanently free.

aiProviderCatalog.name: DeepAI
aiProviderCatalog.notes: DeepAI currently advertises free consumer features, while API access requires Pro.

aiProviderCatalog.name: GitHub Models
aiProviderCatalog.notes: Free tier for any GitHub account (personal access token, models endpoint, rate limited).

aiProviderCatalog.name: Kimi Code
aiProviderCatalog.notes: Kimi Code and Kimi Open Platform are different products with different endpoints and billing.

aiProviderCatalog.name: OpenCode
aiProviderCatalog.notes: OpenCode is an agent/editor gateway, not a single model. It supports 75+ LLM providers and local models.

userActions.detail: Média — activer le rendu réel (TTS + FFmpeg)

directiveManualTasks.title: Média — activer le rendu réel (TTS + FFmpeg)
directiveManualTasks.description: Définir MERDOSS_MEDIA_REAL_RENDER=1 et MERDOSS_TTS_CMD (openai-edge-tts gratuit en local) pour produire audio/vidéo réels au lieu des storyboards.

directiveManualTasks.title: Memberships — comptes plateformes (APIs officielles uniquement)
directiveManualTasks.description: Fournir les identifiants API officiels des plateformes de membership visées (jamais de contournement bot/CAPTCHA par conception). Chaque plateforme activée créera ses propres tâches guidées.

directiveManualTasks.title: Substack — connecter le serveur MCP de la publication
directiveManualTasks.description: Publication: merdoss.substack.com. Connecter https://mcp.substack.com/api/v1/mcp dans les réglages MCP Verdent (authentification au compte Substack requise) pour suivre abonnés/revenus.

directiveManualTasks.title: Minage — brancher un pool réel (matériel local requis)
directiveManualTasks.description: Le cloud Verdent n'a pas de GPU: le minage réel tourne sur la machine locale. Configurer MERDOSS_MINING_POOL_URL/USER/KEY (ex. nanopoool, f2pool) puis basculer accountingMode hors SIMULATED.

directiveManualTasks.title: Etsy — compléter le flux OAuth pour obtenir le refresh token
directiveManualTasks.description: La keystring API est configurée (lecture produits OK). Pour les ventes/commandes réelles, compléter l'OAuth Etsy et coller le refresh token dans My app > Secrets (ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN).

directiveManualTasks.title: Membership gumroad: Verify email
directiveManualTasks.description: Human-gated stage (kind=human_gate). Automation policy forbids bypassing bot-guards.
